pages.name: privacy
pages.title: Privacy Policy | Fleet Services Agency
pages.agentInstructions:
Page purpose: The privacy page explains how visitor information is handled.

Sections:
- TextProseSection: pure-static. Write straightforward policy copy with clear headings and readable paragraphs; keep it legally appropriate and unambiguous.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Fleet Services Agency respects your privacy and is committed to handling personal information responsibly. This policy explains what information we may collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when you visit our website or contact us.
By using this site, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree with any part of it, please discontinue use of the website.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect information you choose to provide, such as your name, company name, email address, phone number, and any message details you send through our contact forms or by email.

We may also collect limited technical information automatically, including browser type, device information, pages visited, approximate location, and referring URLs. This data helps us understand site performance and improve the user experience.

sections.heading: How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use personal information to respond to inquiries, provide quotes, schedule service discussions, deliver requested updates, and maintain business communications with prospective and current customers.

Technical information is used to monitor website performance, troubleshoot issues, improve content, and better understand how visitors use our site. We may also use information to comply with legal obligations and protect our rights.

sections.heading: Sharing Information
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate our website, manage communications, or support our business functions, but only to the extent necessary for those services.
We may also disclose information if required by law, to respond to lawful requests, or to protect the safety, property, or legal rights of Fleet Services Agency, our customers, or others.

sections.heading: Cookies and Analytics
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to support essential functionality, measure traffic, and improve site performance. These tools help us understand which pages are useful and how visitors navigate the site.

You can adjust your browser settings to limit cookies, but some features may not work as intended if you disable them. Where applicable, third-party analytics tools may also collect usage data according to their own policies.

sections.heading: Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, unless a longer retention period is required by law, contract, or legitimate business need.
When information is no longer needed, we take reasonable steps to delete, anonymize, or securely store it in accordance with our internal practices.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or loss.

No method of transmission over the internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. However, we work to maintain protections that are appropriate for the information we handle.

sections.heading: Your Choices
paragraphs: You may contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information you have provided, subject to any legal or contractual limitations that may apply.
If you prefer not to receive follow-up communication from us, you may let us know at any time and we will make reasonable efforts to honor your request.

sections.heading: Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our website may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of those third-party properties.
We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any external sites you visit before providing personal information.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services and website are intended for business use and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
If we learn that a child has provided personal information to us, we will take reasonable steps to delete it promptly.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, services, or legal requirements. When we do, we will revise the last updated date on this page.
Your continued use of the website after changes are posted means you accept the updated policy. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

sections.heading: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle personal information, please contact Fleet Services Agency through the website contact form or the contact details provided elsewhere on the site.
We will review privacy-related requests in a timely manner and respond as appropriate.

items.title: Preventive Maintenance Program
items.imageDescription: Preventive Maintenance Program fleet service technician performing routine inspection on commercial van in industrial service bay
items.imageAlt: Technician performing a preventive maintenance inspection on a commercial fleet van in a service bay
items.typicalTimeline: Program kickoff in 1–2 weeks; ongoing monthly service cadence
items.shortDescription: A structured maintenance plan that keeps your fleet on schedule, reduces downtime, and standardizes service across vehicles.
items.detailedContent:
Our Preventive Maintenance Program is designed for businesses that need consistent, trackable service without the scramble of last-minute repairs. We help you set intervals, standardize checklists, and keep service records organized across the fleet.

We coordinate maintenance based on vehicle use, seasonality, and your operating hours to reduce disruption. The program focuses on practical reliability: catching issues early, improving consistency, and creating a clear service history you can reference anytime.

You’ll get a repeatable cadence, documented recommendations, and a simple process for approvals so you stay in control of cost and timing.

items.title: DOT Compliance & Inspection Support
items.imageDescription: DOT Compliance & Inspection Support fleet service commercial truck undergoing safety inspection with clipboard in industrial lot
items.imageAlt: Inspector reviewing DOT compliance checks on a commercial fleet vehicle with a clipboard
items.shortDescription: Inspection support and documentation help to keep fleet vehicles aligned with safety and compliance expectations.
items.detailedContent:
DOT Compliance & Inspection Support helps businesses stay prepared with organized checks and practical documentation guidance. Whether you operate light-duty fleet units or larger commercial vehicles, we help you build a consistent approach to inspections and records.

We focus on clear, repeatable steps: what to check, what to document, and how to keep information accessible for your team. If issues are found, we provide straightforward recommendations so you can plan next actions without guesswork.

This service is designed to reduce operational risk and make compliance less disruptive to day-to-day work.

items.title: Tire Management & Replacement Planning
items.imageDescription: Tire Management & Replacement Planning fleet service technician inspecting commercial van tires with tread gauge in garage
items.imageAlt: Technician measuring tire tread on a commercial fleet van during a tire management check
items.typicalTimeline: Baseline assessment in 1 week; replacements scheduled as needed
items.shortDescription: A simple tire strategy to reduce unexpected downtime and improve safety across the fleet.
items.detailedContent:
Tire Management & Replacement Planning helps you stay ahead of wear patterns and avoid surprise failures. We start by reviewing current condition, documenting tread and visible issues, and identifying units that need attention soon.

From there, we help you set a replacement approach that matches your operating conditions and routes. The goal is consistency—fewer last-minute emergencies, better planning, and a clear view of what’s coming next.

This service works well alongside preventive maintenance, but it can also be used as a standalone program.

items.title: Mobile Fleet Inspections & Condition Reports
items.imageDescription: Mobile Fleet Inspections & Condition Reports fleet service inspector walking lot with tablet reviewing vehicles parked in rows
items.imageAlt: Inspector using a tablet while conducting mobile inspections of fleet vehicles in a parking lot
items.typicalTimeline: On-site visit scheduled within 5–10 business days
items.shortDescription: On-site inspections with clear condition reporting so you can plan maintenance, repairs, and replacements.
items.detailedContent:
Mobile Fleet Inspections & Condition Reports provide a structured way to understand fleet condition without pulling vehicles out of service for long periods. We can inspect vehicles on-site and capture consistent notes across units.

The output is built for decision-making: what’s urgent, what can wait, and what should be monitored. This helps maintenance planning, budgeting, and internal coordination—especially for businesses with multiple drivers or departments sharing vehicles.

Use this service for periodic health checks, seasonal readiness, or pre-renewal planning.

items.title: Vehicle Upfitting & Equipment Install
items.imageDescription: Vehicle Upfitting & Equipment Install fleet service technician installing shelving in service van interior with tools
items.imageAlt: Technician installing interior shelving and equipment in a commercial service van
items.typicalTimeline: Typical scheduling 2–4 weeks depending on parts and workload
items.shortDescription: Practical upfits for service vans and work vehicles to improve safety, organization, and daily efficiency.
items.detailedContent:
Vehicle Upfitting & Equipment Install supports fleets that need functional, durable setups for real work. We help coordinate common upgrades like interior organization, safety additions, and job-specific equipment placement.

The goal is a clean, consistent build that supports your team’s workflow. We focus on practical outcomes: reduced clutter, safer storage, and easier daily operation.

If you’re standardizing new vehicles or refreshing existing units, we can help you plan a repeatable approach across the fleet.

items.title: Fleet Technology & Tracking Setup
items.imageDescription: Fleet Technology & Tracking Setup fleet service technician configuring vehicle tracking device and laptop inside modern garage
items.imageAlt: Technician configuring fleet tracking technology with a laptop inside a garage
items.typicalTimeline: Planning and rollout in 1–3 weeks depending on fleet size
items.shortDescription: Implementation support for fleet tracking and operational tools, with a focus on smooth rollout and adoption.
items.detailedContent:
Fleet Technology & Tracking Setup helps businesses roll out operational tools in a practical way—focused on getting systems configured, vehicles connected, and teams aligned on process.

We support planning and deployment steps so your rollout is organized and predictable. This service is ideal when you need a coordinated approach across multiple vehicles and stakeholders.

We keep the approach straightforward: define what you need, set up the basics, and help ensure your team knows what to expect.
